meta.name: mtls-configuration
meta.description: Configure mutual TLS (mTLS) for zero-trust service-to-service communication. Use when implementing zero-trust networking, certificate management, or securing internal service communication.

copy.tagline: 配置服务间双向 TLS 认证,建立零信任安全通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在服务之间启用相互 TLS 认证来加固通信安全
copy.tagline_en: Configure mutual TLS for services to enable zero-trust communication
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to secure internal service communication with mTLS.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你为服务之间的通信配置双向 TLS(mTLS):设计从根 CA 到工作负载证书的层级、规划证书轮换与到期监控,并协助排查 TLS 握手失败。
howto.when: 当你要实施零信任网络、做证书管理,或加固内部服务之间的通信时触发。

say.text: 帮我为服务 A 和服务 B 之间配置 mTLS
say.note: 会按双向证书校验的握手流程来做

say.text: 帮我规划从根 CA 到工作负载证书的层级和轮换策略
say.note: 产出证书层级与轮换安排

say.text: 我的服务间 TLS 握手一直失败,帮我排查
say.note: 会检查证书链和校验环节

howto.what_en: Claude configures mutual TLS (mTLS) between services: it designs the root CA to workload certificate hierarchy, plans certificate rotation and expiry monitoring, and helps debug failed TLS handshakes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you implement zero-trust networking, manage certificates, or secure internal service-to-service communication.

say_en.text: Set up mTLS between service A and service B
say_en.note: Runs the mutual certificate handshake flow

say_en.text: Plan the hierarchy from root CA to workload certs and a rotation policy
say_en.note: Returns cert hierarchy and rotation plan

say_en.text: Debug why my service-to-service TLS handshake keeps failing
say_en.note: Checks the cert chain and verification steps
